subject: Annual committed spend — invoicing cadence & drawdown synchronization
messages:
From: Lucia Ramos <lucia.ramos@acme.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Acme Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
Date: 2027-04-02 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Annual commit: invoicing cadence and drawdown mechanism

Hi Markus,

Hope you’re well — we’re getting our procurement plan finalized for the next fiscal year and want to lock the invoicing cadence for the committed spend with Redwood. Our preferred flow is:

- One upfront prepay equal to the committed amount (PO to follow).
- Monthly drawdowns against that prepay based on usage reporting.
- Quarterly reconciliation for over/under usage with credit or additional invoice.

A few items we need clarified before we issue the PO:
1) How you handle VAT for US-headquartered customers with EU usage (we have EU subsidiaries).
2) Sample invoice layout (line items for prepay receipts + monthly consumption debits).
3) A simple audit trail for each drawdown (ledger id, invoice link).

I can attach our standard PO format once we confirm the cadence. Can you propose a template schedule and a tracking sheet that our finance team can use?

Thanks,
Lucia Ramos
Sr. Procurement Manager
Acme Analytics

Attachments: (none yet)
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lucia Ramos <lucia.ramos@acme.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-02 10:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Annual commit: invoicing cadence and drawdown mechanism

Hi Lucia — thanks for the clear outline. Attached is a proposed workflow and a hands-on tracker that maps the prepay to monthly withdrawals and produces an audit row per drawdown. Key points up front:

- We can accept a single upfront payment (PO + vendor invoice) and then perform monthly consumption debits against that balance.
- Each drawdown produces: date, amount, token-usage bucket, internal ledger id (RDW-ACME-YYYYMM-XX), and a link to the monthly consumption invoice.
- Quarterly reconciliations will render a credit note or supplemental invoice depending on net usage variance.

I’ve attached:
- RDW_Acme_Annual_PrePay_Acct_Schedule.xlsx (proposed tranche schedule + ledger mapping)
- RDW-Acme-Prepay-Terms-v1.2.pdf (standard terms including cancellation/unused credit handling)

Notes on VAT: our standard is to surface VAT on the invoice when applicable; for EU-based consumption we can route invoicing through our EU billing entity if you prefer VAT-included invoices. Grace is cc’d and can confirm the EU/VAT flow.

Next steps: if you’re good with the attached schedule, send the PO and we’ll issue the upfront invoice; Vivek will provision the ledger space and share the drawdown sheet (read-only link) for your finance team.

Best,
Markus Klein
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: RDW_Acme_Annual_PrePay_Acct_Schedule.xlsx; RDW-Acme-Prepay-Terms-v1.2.pdf
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lucia Ramos <lucia.ramos@acme.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-02 13:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Annual commit: invoicing cadence & drawdown synchronization

Lucia / Markus — quick tax note from my side:

- If Acme wants VAT-charged invoices for EU entities, we’ll need the EU VAT ID for the billed entity.
- For US-headquartered contracts with cross-border usage, we recommend splitting invoicing by billed entity (US entity for US usage; EU entity for EU usage) to avoid cross-jurisdiction VAT post-facto adjustments.
- If you cannot split the invoices, we can issue the invoice from our EU entity and charge VAT where applicable, but this affects the reporting cadence and requires local tax forms.

I reviewed the schedule in the spreadsheet — the monthly drawdown rows already include a tax_code column. If you send the PO with the nominated billing entity and VAT ID (if EU), we’ll generate the upfront invoice accordingly.

Also cc’ing Vivek for the ledger/linking details so the audit trail matches your AP system.

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Director, Tax & Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: Lucia Ramos <lucia.ramos@acme.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Acme Procurement <procurement@acme.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-02 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Annual commit: invoicing cadence & drawdown synchronization

Markus / team — thanks, that looks good. I’ve attached our PO (PO-ACME-2027-04.pdf) and included the EU VAT ID for our Dublin subsidiary (IE1234567T) — please bill the prepay to Acme Analytics Ltd (EU).

Two quick asks before we finalize:
1) Can you confirm the monthly drawdown email that will arrive to our AP team (we need a stable subject line and a link to the ledger row)?
2) Please send the DocuSign link for the prepay terms and we’ll route internally.

If you can confirm by end of day we’ll route the PO.

Onward —
Lucia Ramos
Sr. Procurement Manager
Acme Analytics

Attachment: PO-ACME-2027-04.pdf (purchase order, 1 page)
